errors.text_span: Industry (жълто), Construction (светлосиньо), Trade (червено) and Other services (тъмносиньо)
errors.evidence: The legend in the figure maps Industry to yellow, Construction to blue, Trade to red, and Other services to dark blue. The description incorrectly says Construction is light blue and Other services is dark blue; the blue/dark blue mapping is wrong.

errors.text_span: В диаграмата за „Turnover“ са изписани проценти и стойности в трилиони: Industry (жълто) 33% и 10.6 tln, Construction (светлосиньо) 6% и 1.9 tln, Trade (червено) 31% и 9.9 tln, Other services (тъмносиньо) 31% и 9.8 tln.
errors.evidence: In the turnover donut, Industry is the yellow 33%/10.6 tln segment and Other services is the blue 31%/9.8 tln segment. Because the legend colors are misassigned, this whole mapping is incorrect.
The description does not mention the visible title at the top of the figure or the subtitle indicating the measure is '% of sector in total economy, absolute values, by NACE Rev. 2'.
